page_title: INT 2-1 UDI | Inter v Udinese 30/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Daniele Chiffi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Simone Pafundi (Udinese) whips in a cross from the corner, but Yann Sommer is well positioned and punches the ball away.
90+5' Martin Payero (Udinese) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
90+4' This is a yellow card! Nicolo Barella (Inter) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+2' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Simone Inzaghi, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
90+2' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+2' Oumar Solet (Udinese) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the right-hand post. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Yann Sommer with a fabulous save.
90+2' The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' The ball is cleared after Joaquin Correa (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
86' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 60:40.
84' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
83' Joaquin Correa (Inter) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
82' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
79' Substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp will be replaced by Simone Pafundi (Udinese).
77' Martin Payero (Udinese) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
76' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Matteo Darmian and he is replaced by Nicola Zalewski (Inter).
75' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) connects with a cross and heads towards the top left corner of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.

71' 2 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Oumar Solet (Udinese) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the left post. Yann Sommer just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:1.
70' Substitution. Arthur Atta makes his way off the pitch and Martin Payero (Udinese) comes on as his replacement.
70' A substitution has been made. Jesper Karlstrom goes off and Oier Zarraga (Udinese) comes on.
70' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Rui Modesto (Udinese) replaces Hassane Kamara.
69' Arthur Atta (Udinese) brings his opponent down. Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Inter.
66' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) dribbles into the box, but Yann Sommer is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
65' Arthur Atta (Udinese) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hakan Calhanoglu departs the field of play to be replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
63' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolo Barella (Inter) replacing Davide Frattesi.
63' Today's match ends for Federico Dimarco who will be replaced by Yann Bisseck (Inter).
62' Federico Dimarco (Inter) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar.
61' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Benjamin Pavard (Inter). Udinese have a free kick.

58' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for an infringement. Inter win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
56' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
55' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Marko Arnautovic as he is replaced by Joaquin Correa (Inter).
54' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
53' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
51' Federico Dimarco (Inter) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
51' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
49' So close! Iker Bravo (Udinese) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
47' Simone Inzaghi is stunned as referee Daniele Chiffi shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
47' Marcus Thuram (Inter) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' Kosta Runjaic makes a switch. Iker Bravo (Udinese) is coming on in place of Sandi Lovric at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Daniele Chiffi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Marcus Thuram (Inter) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
42' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
40' The free kick from long range, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' CHANCE! Davide Frattesi (Inter) receives a brilliant pass and finds himself one-on-one with Maduka Okoye, who reacts superbly to stop him.
37' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Yann Sommer makes a comfortable save.
35' The game is interrupted now, Hassane Kamara (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' A lofted cross from Matteo Darmian (Inter) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
29' 2 - 0 Davide Frattesi (Inter) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
28' Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Federico Dimarco (Inter). There is a free kick near the sideline to Udinese.
27' Half-chance! Marko Arnautovic (Inter) plays a pass into the box, but Maduka Okoye reacts well to snuff out the attack.
26' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
25' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
24' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
22' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Udinese.
20' Marcus Thuram (Inter) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
19' Arthur Atta (Udinese) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Chiffi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
17' Chance! Davide Frattesi (Inter) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
15' Udinese concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Inter win a free kick.
12' 1 - 0 Goal! Marko Arnautovic (Inter) latches on to an accurate pass and quickly strikes a low effort inside the right post.
12' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
10' Matteo Darmian (Inter) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
8' Davide Frattesi (Inter) hits the left post with a rebound from near the penalty spot.
7' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
5' What a big chance! Marko Arnautovic (Inter) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
3' The linesman signals a throw-in for Inter.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniele Chiffi.
